hero.description: A production-ready financial management system demonstrating Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and modern full-stack development patterns. Built with Next.js 16, Go, and PostgreSQL.

architecture.title: Clean Architecture
architecture.description: The backend follows Clean Architecture principles with clear separation of concerns. Dependencies point inward, keeping the core domain independent of frameworks.
architecture.dependencyRule: Dependencies always point inward → Domain never depends on outer layers

patterns.title: Patterns Implemented
patterns.description: Industry-standard design patterns ensuring maintainability, testability, and clean code.

repository.name: Repository Pattern
repository.description: Abstract data access behind interfaces, enabling easy testing with mocks and database swapping.

dependencyInjection.name: Dependency Injection
dependencyInjection.description: Services receive dependencies via constructors, promoting loose coupling and testability.

dto.name: DTO Pattern
dto.description: Separate request/response objects from domain entities to control API contracts.

factory.name: Factory Pattern
factory.description: Constructor functions create domain entities with proper initialization.

techStack.title: Technologies Used
techStack.description: A modern, production-ready stack optimized for performance, developer experience, and scalability.

highlights.title: Key Implementations
highlights.description: Notable technical features and engineering decisions that make this project production-ready.

jwt.title: JWT Authentication
jwt.description: Stateless token-based auth with bcrypt password hashing and configurable expiration.

migrations.title: Database Migrations
migrations.description: Version-controlled migrations with golang-migrate, on PostgreSQL in production and in tests (testcontainers).

workers.title: Background Workers
workers.description: Scheduled jobs for recurring transactions with graceful shutdown handling.

cache.title: In-Memory Cache
cache.description: Transaction caching layer with 5-minute TTL for improved read performance.

logging.title: Structured Logging
logging.description: Zerolog for JSON-formatted logs with configurable levels and correlation IDs.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: Full i18n support (ES/EN) using next-intl with type-safe translations.

repository.title: Open Source
repository.description: Explore the code, learn from the implementation, or contribute to the project.
